analysis.headline: No Sharing Or Selling
analysis.quote: We will not share, exchange, or sell your email address and other provided personal information to third parties.

analysis.headline: Google Analytics Tracks You
analysis.quote: The main MIT website uses Google Analytics to gather anonymous statistics.

analysis.headline: Your Data Kept Lifelong
analysis.quote: We consider our relationship with the MIT community to be lifelong. This means that we will maintain a record for you until such time as you tell us that you no longer wish us to keep in touch.

analysis.headline: No 100% Security Guarantee
analysis.quote: However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure.

analysis.headline: Your Data Goes To US
analysis.quote: By providing information directly to MIT, you consent to the transfer of your personal information outside of the European Economic Area to the United States.

analysis.headline: Your Erased Data Retained
analysis.quote: Upon a request to erase information, we will maintain a core set of personal data to ensure we do not contact you inadvertently in the future, as well as any information necessary for MIT archival purposes.

analysis.headline: Many Sites Out Of Scope
analysis.quote: In addition to the main MIT website, MIT departments, labs, centers, and individuals publish many other websites and pages outside the scope of this privacy statement, which may post and adhere to their own privacy statements.

analysis.headline: Consent To Weaker US Laws
analysis.quote: You understand that the current laws and regulations of the United States may not provide the same level of protection as the data and privacy laws and regulations of the EEA.
